versions.changelog:
Initial release of edgrapi-filings skill.

- Provides company profile details (CIK, industry, fiscal-year end, exchange) and recent SEC filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K) for US-listed companies via Edgrapi.com.
- Includes two main tools: `get_company` (company metadata) and `get_filings` (recent filings with document links).
- Requires an Edgrapi API key for authentication.
- Each request consumes one Edgrapi credit.
- Comprehensive error handling and clear usage guidelines included.
